snippet.title: Carbox – Official Trailer | Coming This December to Steam
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2010100

Race across an ever-growing collection of tracks and challenges, unlock tons of cars, win cups, and explore user-generated maps. Build and share your own worlds and circuits with the powerful, easy-to-use World Editor, and prove your skills on our global leaderboards!
